cases.purpose: bashkmod modprobe -n prints the insmod plan (dependency chain deepest-first, absolute paths, PARAMS on the last module) equal to kmod modprobe -n -v on the live modules.dep
cases.oracle: kmod modprobe -n -v in the guest on the live /lib/modules/$(uname -r)/modules.dep
cases.comparison: Line-for-line equality of the insmod plan for a single module with parameters and for a multi-module dependency chain (br_netfilter).
cases.script:
[[ $UID == 2000 && $EUID == 2000 && $PWD == /tmp/parity-case && $HOME == /tmp/parity-home ]] || exit 125
IFS= read -r marker </etc/bashos-parity-vm || exit 125
IFS= read -r vendor </sys/class/dmi/id/sys_vendor || exit 125
[[ $vendor == QEMU && $marker =~ ^[0-9a-fA-F]{8}-[0-9a-fA-F]{4}-[0-9a-fA-F]{4}-[0-9a-fA-F]{4}-[0-9a-fA-F]{12}$ ]] || exit 125
[[ $(type -t bashkmod) == builtin ]] || exit 125
cmp1() { local label=$1; shift
  local mine ref
  mine=$(bashkmod modprobe -n "$@" 2>&1); local rc=$?
  ref=$(/usr/sbin/modprobe -n -v "$@" 2>&1)
  echo "$label: rc=$rc plan-nonempty=$([[ $ref == insmod* ]] && echo 1 || echo 0) equal-to-kmod=$([[ $mine == "$ref" ]] && echo 1 || echo 0)"
}
cmp1 single nbd nbds_max=4 max_part=2
cmp1 chain br_netfilter
cmp1 chain-params ip_set max_sets=64
cases.stdout:
single: rc=0 plan-nonempty=1 equal-to-kmod=1
chain: rc=0 plan-nonempty=1 equal-to-kmod=1
chain-params: rc=0 plan-nonempty=1 equal-to-kmod=1
